purpose: Enable the shared Portfolio state/report architecture for AP Calculus AB while exact Unit Assessment Plans own learning content. Unit 1 evidence/report grading is authority-ready; course Practice Builder routing is not yet available.

mastered_default_rule.normal_requirement: At least two independent convincing demonstrations, normally from different opportunities, unless a rich artifact supplies genuinely independent evidence.
mastered_default_rule.accommodations: Approved accommodations do not lower the evidence status of a valid demonstration.

mastery_goal_rule.general_rule: A Mastery Goal is demonstrated when at least half of its exact I Cans, rounded up, are Mastered or Transfer.

mastery_goal_grade_model.not_assessed_rule: No usable evidence anywhere in the goal -> Not assessed and blank PowerSchool Score.
mastery_goal_grade_model.general_scale_rule: Let n be exact I Can count and t=ceil(n/2). If assessed: I for secure<t; C for secure=t; B for t<secure<n; A for secure=n; A+ for secure=n plus meaningful transfer evidence in the goal.
mastery_goal_grade_model.unit_grade_rule: No overall Unit letter grade is reported or exported.

powerschool.output_rule: Produce one CSV per Mastery Goal per period; no Unit-grade CSV.

student_practice_link.missing_builder_rule: List focus I Cans on the student report but do not fabricate a QR/link. Calculus Practice Builder requires a later course-repo build.

intervention_routing.priority_day_group: At least two students sharing the exact same substantial-gap bundle of 2-4 I Cans.

1.note: Exact Unit 1 Mastery Goals and I Can statements are derived from the current Assessment Plan; report focus list is available but no Practice Builder QR/link is emitted.

unit_readiness.2-8: ASSESSMENT_PLAN_EXISTS_BUT_PORTFOLIO_MAPPING_NOT_YET_VERIFIED; roster/support maintenance allowed, evidence grading fails closed until deliberately verified.
